rows.en:
(I went a bit farther out while I was shopping,
but the damage has spread all the way out here...)

\p-kun...
What are you doing in a place like this?

I could ask you the same, Senpai.
It's dangerous around here.
I wanted to see the damage with my own eyes.

This is our city, after all...
We have to protect it...
Right, let's do our best!

Mm, it's good to stay positive.
See you.

(Our city, huh... I don't know what I can do,
but I've got to do whatever I can...)

(I went a bit farther out while I was shopping,
but the damage has spread all the way out here...)

\p-chan...
What are you doing in a place like this?

I could ask you the same, Senpai.
It's dangerous around here...

(Our city, huh... I don't know what I can do,
but I've got to do whatever I can...)
(Tests are finally over...)
You look totally wiped out.

Claire-senpai...
Tests are finally over, so I'm all deflated.
How did you do?
So-so, I guess...
You have to study properly every day, you know.
I can't argue with that...

Hehe... Don't look so down.
Just do better next time, okay?
...Oh, okay!
(Claire-senpai is so kind.)
(Phew, tests are finally over...)

So-so?
...Kinda?
Ugh, I can't argue with that...
(Maybe I'll splurge and eat out today.)

Oh, \p-kun.
Heading home?

Yes. I was just thinking
I might splurge on a meal out.

Ooh, sounds nice...
So what are you planning to eat?

A lavish yakiniku feast!
At the very least, I want a hamburger steak.
Meat, huh...
You don't like it, Claire-senpai?
I don't dislike it... but I'm not especially fond of it.
O-Oh, really... But it's so good.

Don't worry about me.
Go eat whatever you like.
(I'll shake it off and go for pasta, I guess.)

Oh, \p-chan.
Heading home?

A lavish yakiniku feast!
At the very least, I want a hamburger steak!
Huh, you don't like it, Claire-senpai?
(I'll shake it off and go for pasta, I guess.)

(Argh, I went to the bathroom and now I'm late...
The teacher's gonna chew me out if I'm tardy!)
Kyaa!
Geez, watch where you're going...

I-I'm sorry...
Claire-senpai...
Are you hurt?

I'm fine, so don't make that face!
It's my fault too for not looking where I was going...

Okay.
Class is about to start, so let's hurry.
(...Claire-senpai is so soft...)

(Argh, I went to the restroom and now I'm late...
The teacher's gonna scold me if I'm tardy!)
(What should I have for lunch...)

Oh, \p-kun.
Off to eat?
Yes, I'm starving.
I'm starving too.
What are you having, Senpai?
Let's see... Pasta, maybe?
Do you like pasta?
Mm~, I like Italian food in general.
It's so good, right? Like carbonara...

Mm... Ah, now I'm getting hungry...!
See you later!
(I'll have carbonara today.)
(Lunch break, huh... What should I eat...)

Oh, \p-chan.
Off to eat?
What are you having, Senpai?
Do you like pasta?

uncertain: c16036 (Claire, "un"): answers the player's "Are you hurt?" after her reassurance; rendered "Okay." as a wrap-up before hurrying to class.
c16037 (shared m/f): "(...Claire-senpai is so soft...)" after bumping into her; kept as is for both genders, as in the Japanese.
c16002: also used in nml_kgr_006 and nml_rnk_006 (male); generic, fits all.
c16019/c16027: yakiniku kept as "yakiniku" (Japanese grilled meat), hambagu as "hamburger steak".
